nodes.subtreeText: The binding is still respected everywhere else in the operating system, it's only Visual Studio Code that ignores it for some reason.

Run setxkbmap -option caps:escape (binds caps to escape for the duration of the session) Hitting caps lock when in insert mode (with a Vim extension like VSCodeVim installed) no longer puts you normal mode. Hitting escape still works as expected and puts you in normal mode.
